source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Check NVLink via cmd: dcgmi nvlink --errors -g <GPU-ID>

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: All GPUs' NVLink should have no errors.

deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: Full per-GPU error output, all links zero.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; correctly identifies read-only counters but omits the source per-GPU target, stable mapping, topology and cumulative-counter interpretation.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds compatible DCGM, UUID/DCGM map, expected topology and no-counter-clear boundary but classifies package/approval as partial.

original_test_intent: For every expected GPU-to-peer NVLink, collect DCGM link error counters, verify the complete topology is represented, and identify any nonzero or newly increasing error according to the project policy.
original_method: Validate compatible DCGM, map stable GPU UUIDs to DCGM entity IDs and expected peers/links, execute the source per-GPU error query for all targets, retain complete counters/unsupported fields, and compare with topology and counter-baseline policy.
manual_activity: An authorized user supplies/approves package and topology policy. Installation if required, read-only querying and comparison are machine-executable; package/approval alone do not make the core PARTIAL.
required_inputs: Approved DCGM/dcgmi version compatible with driver/GPU
GPU UUID/PCI/slot to DCGM ID mapping
Expected NVLink peer/link topology and absent/disabled-link rules
Definition of zero versus baseline/delta for cumulative counters
safety_requirements: Use read-only DCGM queries only; do not clear counters, reset GPUs/NVLinks or alter topology.
Resolve every DCGM ID to stable UUID and expected peer; do not rely on enumeration order.
Preserve all link rows, N/A/unsupported and command errors instead of filtering zero lines.
Do not auto-install an unapproved package or retry through service/driver resets.
agent_execution_scope: Validate package compatibility and build stable GPU/link topology mapping.
Run `dcgmi nvlink --errors -g <approved_gpu_id>` for every mapped GPU and retain raw output/return codes.
Compare represented links and counters to the approved topology/baseline policy and report Tool Result.
engineer_actions: Approve DCGM package, identity/topology and counter interpretation policy.
Resolve disabled/absent/unsupported links or historical counters.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its global read-only query is useful but does not preserve the source `-g <GPU-ID>` coverage or prove every expected link; zero on an absent link is not topology proof.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the exact source per-GPU command, iterating the approved DCGM-ID map and keeping full per-link evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: `dcgmi nvlink --errors -g <GPU-ID>`, all-GPU zero-error criterion, script URL and 2/2-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a UUID/DCGM-ID/peer-link matrix, collect complete per-link counters at named timestamps and apply topology plus cumulative-counter policy without clearing state.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: NVLink-capable NVIDIA GPUs supported by the approved DCGM/driver combination.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record DCGM/dcgmi, driver, GPU firmware, NVSwitch firmware if present, OS/kernel and topology.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: NVIDIA DCGM dcgmi documentation for the deployed version and project NVLink topology specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds stable identity, topology completeness and baseline semantics without replacing DCGM or clearing counters.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; every expected link on every GPU is required.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Cumulative historical errors may be nonzero without a new fault; topology and time context are essential.

project_override_considerations: A project may define absent/disabled links and baseline/delta handling. It must list actual GPUs/links and cannot claim all-link coverage from an unscoped command.
expected_evidence: Expected GPU-peer-link topology and counter policy
Full per-GPU/per-link dcgmi output with return codes/timestamps
Topology coverage plus raw/baseline/delta error comparison
Kernel/BMC/DCGM health, Tool Result and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The command and criterion consistently target NVLink errors. Missing topology/counter policy is readiness, not contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Collection is well-defined once package and map are supplied; these inputs do not make the case permanently blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps its read-only approach but restores source per-GPU coverage and topology/counter semantics.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains package, mapping, topology and no-clear safeguards while correcting classification to FULLY AUTOMATABLE under V3.1.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates package readiness, Tool Result and engineer verdict and requires all expected links rather than a generic zero statement.

review_improvement: Prevents zero counters on an incomplete or wrongly mapped topology from being accepted and preserves cumulative evidence without destructive clearing.
independent_technical_reasoning: After approved package provisioning, all core actions are read-only machine queries and comparisons. No physical setup or human observation is inherent, so FULLY AUTOMATABLE is correct.

source_provenance.history: review_round_02_functionality.md exact-code entry and repository exact-code search

no_automatic_retry: Do not clear counters, reset links/GPUs, restart DCGM or repeat automatically after a missing/error result; preserve evidence for engineering review.
